intent: PSI-051: Wire Kanban board to Supabase queries and Server Actions with fractional indexing moves.
summary: Replaced mock Kanban data with Supabase queries and Server Actions. Implemented fractional indexing via positionBetween in src/features/kanban/lib/position.ts, added getBoardAction, createTaskAction, moveTaskAction, deleteTaskAction, and updateTaskAction in src/features/kanban/actions.ts, wired KanbanBoard with TanStack Query and optimistic drag-and-drop single-row position updates, and updated NewTaskDialog to create tasks directly in PostgreSQL.

changes.note: Server Actions for Kanban board, task creation, and move operations
TanStack Query board with optimistic drag-and-drop and fractional indexing updates
Dialog for creating tasks in database
Page container with dynamic column mapping for new task dialog

decisions.decision: Use fractional-indexing generateKeyBetween with TanStack Query optimistic updates
decisions.reason: Allows single-row DB writes during drag-and-drop moves while ensuring instantaneous UI response and rollback safety.

dependencies_added.reason: Fractional index generation for drag-and-drop list ordering
